name: restful-template
description: TZW LTD Fire Extinguisher Management System with a TypeScript RESTful microservices-oriented API gateway, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, JWT/OTP auth, RBAC, Swagger, reports, exports, and Mantine UI.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace backend && concurrently "npm run start:auth --workspace backend" "npm run start:users --workspace backend" "npm run start:extinguishers --workspace backend" "npm run start:inspection-maintenance --workspace backend" "npm run start:reports --workspace backend" "npm run start:notifications --workspace backend" "npm run start:gateway --workspace backend"
scripts.start:backend: concurrently "npm run start:auth --workspace backend" "npm run start:users --workspace backend" "npm run start:extinguishers --workspace backend" "npm run start:inspection-maintenance --workspace backend" "npm run start:reports --workspace backend" "npm run start:notifications --workspace backend" "npm run start:gateway --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
